title: Chip
description: One chip: a record of the chips list of its family's file config/chips/<producer>/<family>.yml (the check applies this schema to each record). The part number as the vendor writes it — what a board's chip / chips name and a rig's part: selects — and the toolchains that build for it when they differ from the family's default_toolchains.

id.description: The part number as the vendor writes it

toolchains.description: This chip's toolchains when they differ from the family's, as <toolchain>[<version constraint>]
